children: J.Jill reported second-quarter fiscal 2026 results with net sales of $154.8 million, a 0.5% increase versus the prior year, and net income of $16.8 million. Gross profit for the quarter was $119.0 million, yielding a 76.8% gross margin that includes a $13.3 million pre-tax IEEPA tariff refund; adjusted gross margin excluding that refund was 68.3%. The company raised its full-year outlook and provided third-quarter and full-year guidance incorporating tariff refunds and planned strategic investments.
Revenue: Net sales for Q2 FY26 of $154.8 million, up 0.5% versus Q2 FY25 ($154.0 million).
Gross profit and margin: Gross profit of $119.0 million; gross margin 76.8% in Q2 FY26 (68.3% excluding $13.3M net tariff refunds).
Operating income: Operating income of $24.3 million for Q2 FY26 (operating margin 15.7%).
Net income and EPS: Net income of $16.8 million for Q2 FY26; diluted net income per share $1.11.
Adjusted results: Adjusted EBITDA for Q2 FY26 of $32.8 million (21.2% margin) and adjusted diluted EPS of $1.24, both including the tariff refund benefit.
Channel performance: Direct-to-consumer net sales represented 47.1% of net sales in Q2 and increased 1.9% year-over-year; total company comparable sales rose 0.5% for the quarter.

Customer & marketing: Management reported stabilizing customer file and accelerating new-to-brand acquisition; proceeds from tariff refunds will be deployed toward marketing to build the brand and accelerate file growth, split between Q3 and Q4.
Store footprint: End-of-quarter store count was 255 stores (unchanged in the quarter; net +8 stores year-over-year versus 247 stores at prior-year quarter end).

Cash flow and liquidity: Cash balance at quarter end of $76.9 million; net cash provided by operating activities was $46.3 million for the quarter (benefitted from $19.0 million gross tariff refunds); free cash flow for the quarter was $44.0 million.

Capital allocation: Repurchased 99,902 shares in the quarter ($1.5M) and had $11.8M remaining under a $25.0M repurchase authorization; announced quarterly cash dividend of $0.09 per share (subsequent dividend declared September 2, 2026).
